description: Start an appointment request for Xona to send to the selected clinic (by email, or through the clinic's own website form). It takes the patient's details and preferred times. Xona emails the patient a link that shows the exact request; the request goes to the clinic only when the patient presses "Send this request" there, or enters the email's code on continue_url. The result carries consent_text and continue_url; confirm_dental_request reports the status. Use it where list_dental_practice_actions marks xona_email_appointment_request as completes_in_conversation.

patient_email.description: The patient's own email; the link to send the request goes there

patient_name.description: The patient's name as they typed it

patient_phone.description: The patient's phone as they typed it; required when the clinic's website form needs one

preferred_window.description: When the patient is free, in their words

name: start_dental_request
title: Start a dental appointment request
